description: This file contains the implementation of the Normal distribution functions used in the PhpSpreadsheet library, including methods for calculating the probability density function (PDF), cumulative distribution function (CDF), and inverse CDF for the normal distribution.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating probabilities related to the normal distribution, including PDF, CDF, and inverse CDF functions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the value of the normal distribution's PDF or CDF based on the 'cumulative' parameter.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the normal cumulative distribution function for a given probability.
